modeling_rule: A concept is a relationship meaning, not an assertion that every language has one basic word for it. A language entry may supply several conditioned forms or a transparent descriptive phrase. Games must use conditions when a target language lexicalizes distinctions such as relative age, speaker gender, maternal/paternal side, or exact genealogical path.
